name: Hinosaka Honoka
source: Honoka, the woman who introduces Osamu to the "Terrace House Hinosaka," is a person of deep sentimentality and gentleness. Yet, she's somewhat susceptible to influence and often finds herself moved to tears by the sorrow of men. She vanishes in an unexpected turn of events, leaving behind her daughter, Mitoko.
